# Do not change these options in this file. Use cmake.config, cmake -DOPTION=VALUE, or ccmake to specify them.
option(USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS "Use the InfiniOps execution provider" ON)
option(USE_INFINIOPS_ATEN_KERNELS
       "Use ATen implementations generated by InfiniOps" ON)
option(USE_BACKTRACE "Print backtrace on exception and segmentation fault" ON)
option(USE_PROTOBUF "Serialize and deserialize tensors" OFF)
option(BUILD_NNET "Build nnet" OFF)
option(BUILD_DIST "Build project for distributed running" OFF)
option(USE_INFINICCL "Use InfiniCCL for distributed communication" OFF)
option(BUILD_TEST "Build tests" OFF)

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.17)

if(POLICY CMP0144)
  cmake_policy(SET CMP0144 NEW)
endif()

include(CMakeDependentOption)
project(InfiniTensor C CXX)

cmake_dependent_option(BUILD_TEST_CORE "Build tests for core components" ON BUILD_TEST OFF)
cmake_dependent_option(BUILD_TEST_PET "Build tests for PET" OFF BUILD_TEST OFF)

set(DEFAULT_BUILD_TYPE "RelWithDebInfo")
# Build Type
if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
    message("Configuring for Debug build.")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -g -O0")
    add_compile_definitions(DEBUG_MODE)
elseif(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Release")
    message("Configuring for Release build.")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -O2")
    add_compile_definitions(NDEBUG)
elseif(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "RelWithDebInfo")
    message("Configuring for RelWithDebInfo build.")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -g -O2")
else()
    message("Build type not specified. Configuring for RelWithDebInfo build.")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -g -O2")
endif()


if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config.cmake)
  message(STATUS "Using config.cmake in CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR directory")
  include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config.cmake)
else()
  if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config.cmake)
    message(STATUS "Using config.cmake in CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR directory")
    include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config.cmake)
  endif()
endif()

set(INFINIOPS_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "InfiniOps installation prefix")
set(INFINIRT_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "InfiniRT installation prefix")
set(INFINIOPS_CXX11_ABI "" CACHE STRING "C++11 ABI used to build InfiniOps")
set(INFINICCL_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "InfiniCCL installation prefix")
if(USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS AND NOT INFINIOPS_ROOT)
  message(STATUS "INFINIOPS_ROOT is unset; disabling the InfiniOps execution provider")
  set(USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS OFF)
  set(USE_INFINIOPS_ATEN_KERNELS OFF)
endif()
if(NOT USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS AND USE_INFINIOPS_ATEN_KERNELS)
  message(STATUS "Disabling InfiniOps ATen kernels because the InfiniOps execution provider is disabled")
  set(USE_INFINIOPS_ATEN_KERNELS OFF)
endif()

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF) # -std=gnu++11 when on, -std=c++11 when off
add_compile_options(-Wno-error=unused-variable)

if(NOT INFINIOPS_CXX11_ABI STREQUAL "")
  if(NOT INFINIOPS_CXX11_ABI MATCHES "^[01]$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "INFINIOPS_CXX11_ABI must be 0 or 1")
  endif()
  add_compile_definitions(_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=${INFINIOPS_CXX11_ABI})
endif()

# REF: 
# 1. https://gcc.gnu.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=107852
# 2. https://github.com/assimp/assimp/pull/5577
if(((CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU") AND NOT MINGW AND NOT HAIKU) AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION GREATER_EQUAL 13)
  message(STATUS "GCC13 or later detected, disabling \"-Warray-bounds and -Wstringop-overflow\" for all source files as it appears to be a false positive")
  add_compile_options(-Wno-array-bounds -Wno-stringop-overflow)
endif()

find_package(
  Python
  COMPONENTS Interpreter Development
  REQUIRED)

# OpenMP
find_package(OpenMP)
if(OpenMP_C_FOUND)
  set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${OpenMP_C_FLAGS}")
endif()
if(OpenMP_CXX_FOUND)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${OpenMP_CXX_FLAGS}")
endif()

#Protobuf
if(USE_PROTOBUF)
  add_definitions(-D TENSOR_PROTOBUF)
  find_package(Protobuf REQUIRED)
  message(STATUS "protobuf include: " ${PROTOBUF_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  message(STATUS "protobuf libraries: " ${PROTOBUF_LIBRARIES})
  message(STATUS "protoc executable: " ${PROTOBUF_PROTOC_EXECUTABLE})
  include_directories(${PROTOBUF_INCLUDE_DIR})
  include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
  set(PROTO_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/proto")
  file(GLOB PROTO_FILES "${PROTO_PATH}/data.proto")
  protobuf_generate_cpp(PROTO_SRCS PROTO_HDRS ${PROTO_FILES})
  set_source_files_properties (${PROTO_SRCS} PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS -Wno-unused-variable)
  add_library(tensor_proto SHARED ${PROTO_SRCS} ${PROTO_HDRS})
  target_link_libraries(tensor_proto PUBLIC ${PROTOBUF_LIBRARIES})
endif()

include_directories(include)
# Pybind11
add_subdirectory(3rd-party/pybind11)
include_directories(3rd-party/pybind11/include)

# nlohmann_json
add_subdirectory(3rd-party/nlohmann_json_cmake_fetchcontent)
include_directories(3rd-party/nlohmann_json_cmake_fetchcontent/single_include)

# TVM backend
if(BUILD_NNET AND BUILD_TEST)
  # TVM and DMLC for invoking TVM packed functions
  include_directories(${TVM_INCLUDE_DIR})
  include_directories(${DMLC_INCLUDE_DIR})
  include_directories(${DLPACK_INCLUDE_DIR})
  if (TVM_INCLUDE_DIR AND DMLC_INCLUDE_DIR AND DLPACK_INCLUDE_DIR AND DLPACK_INCLUDE_DIR)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -DDMLC_USE_LOGGING_LIBRARY=\\\<${TVM_INCLUDE_DIR}/tvm/runtime/logging.h\\\> ")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -DINFINI_USE_TVM=1") # Enable TVM codegen kernels
  else()
    # message(FATAL_ERROR "TVM_INCLUDE_DIR, DMLC_INCLUDE_DIR, and DLPACK_INCLUDE_DIR must be set when BUILD_NNET AND BUILD_TEST is ON")
  endif()
endif()

if(BUILD_TEST)
  set(BUILD_GMOCK
      OFF
      CACHE BOOL "Do not build gmock" FORCE)
  set(INSTALL_GTEST
      OFF
      CACHE BOOL "Do not install gtest" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory(3rd-party/googletest)
  include_directories(3rd-party/googletest/googletest/include)
endif()

if(USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS)
  if(NOT INFINIOPS_ROOT)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "INFINIOPS_ROOT must be set when USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS is ON")
  endif()

  if(NOT INFINIRT_ROOT)
    set(INFINIRT_ROOT "${INFINIOPS_ROOT}")
  endif()

  find_package(InfiniRT CONFIG REQUIRED
    PATHS "${INFINIRT_ROOT}/lib/cmake/InfiniRT"
    NO_DEFAULT_PATH)

  find_path(INFINIOPS_INCLUDE_DIR
    NAMES infini/ops.h
    PATHS "${INFINIOPS_ROOT}/include"
    NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
  find_library(INFINIOPS_LIBRARY
    NAMES infiniops
    PATHS "${INFINIOPS_ROOT}" "${INFINIOPS_ROOT}/lib"
    NO_DEFAULT_PATH)

  if(NOT INFINIOPS_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT INFINIOPS_LIBRARY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Could not find InfiniOps headers/libraries under INFINIOPS_ROOT=${INFINIOPS_ROOT}")
  endif()
  if(NOT TARGET InfiniRT::infinirt)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "InfiniRT::infinirt is unavailable under INFINIRT_ROOT=${INFINIRT_ROOT}")
  endif()

  get_filename_component(INFINIOPS_LIBRARY_DIR "${INFINIOPS_LIBRARY}" DIRECTORY)
  set(INFINIRT_LIBRARY_DIR "${INFINIRT_ROOT}/lib")
  set(INFINIOPS_RUNTIME_LIBRARY_DIRS
      "${INFINIOPS_LIBRARY_DIR}" "${INFINIRT_LIBRARY_DIR}")
  list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES INFINIOPS_RUNTIME_LIBRARY_DIRS)
endif()

if(BUILD_DIST AND NOT USE_INFINICCL)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "BUILD_DIST requires USE_INFINICCL=ON; direct vendor collective backends are no longer used")
endif()

if(USE_INFINICCL AND NOT USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS)
  message(FATAL_ERROR
          "USE_INFINICCL requires USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS=ON because communication kernels use the InfiniRuntime stream")
endif()

if(USE_INFINICCL)
  if(NOT INFINICCL_ROOT)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "INFINICCL_ROOT must be set when USE_INFINICCL is ON")
  endif()
  find_path(INFINICCL_INCLUDE_DIR
    NAMES comm.h
    PATHS "${INFINICCL_ROOT}/include"
          "${INFINICCL_ROOT}/include/infiniccl"
    NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
  find_library(INFINICCL_LIBRARY NAMES infiniccl PATHS "${INFINICCL_ROOT}" "${INFINICCL_ROOT}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
  if(NOT INFINICCL_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT INFINICCL_LIBRARY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Could not find InfiniCCL headers/library under INFINICCL_ROOT=${INFINICCL_ROOT}")
  endif()
  get_filename_component(INFINICCL_LIBRARY_DIR "${INFINICCL_LIBRARY}" DIRECTORY)
endif()

set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -g -Wall -Werror -Wno-error=deprecated-declarations -Wno-error=pointer-arith")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE} -UNDEBUG") # Enable assertion
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO} -UNDEBUG") # Enable assertion


# Source files
file(GLOB_RECURSE SRC src/ffi/*.cc src/core/*.cc src/kernels/cpu/*.cc src/operators/*.cc src/utils/*.cc)
list(REMOVE_ITEM SRC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/core/infini_runtime.cc")

if(USE_INFINICCL)
  file(GLOB_RECURSE SRC_INFINICCL src/communication/*.cc)
  list(APPEND SRC ${SRC_INFINICCL})
endif()

if(BUILD_NNET)
  add_compile_definitions(BUILD_NNET=1)
  file(GLOB_RECURSE SRC_NNET src/nnet/*.cc)
  list (APPEND SRC ${SRC_NNET})
  # For locating resource files
  set_source_files_properties(src/nnet/test.cc PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-DINFINI_PROJECT_HOME=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()

if(USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS)
  file(GLOB_RECURSE SRC_INFINIOPS_KERNELS src/kernels/infiniops/*.cc)
  list(APPEND SRC src/core/infini_runtime.cc ${SRC_INFINIOPS_KERNELS})
endif()

# Libraries
add_library(InfiniTensor SHARED ${SRC})
if(USE_PROTOBUF)
  target_link_libraries(InfiniTensor tensor_proto)
endif()

target_link_libraries(InfiniTensor pybind11::embed)

if(USE_INFINICCL)
  target_compile_definitions(InfiniTensor PRIVATE USE_INFINICCL=1)
  target_include_directories(InfiniTensor PRIVATE ${INFINICCL_INCLUDE_DIR})
  target_link_libraries(InfiniTensor ${INFINICCL_LIBRARY})
  if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    set_property(TARGET InfiniTensor APPEND PROPERTY BUILD_RPATH "${INFINICCL_LIBRARY_DIR}")
  endif()
endif()

if(USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS)
  target_compile_definitions(InfiniTensor PRIVATE USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS=1)
  if(USE_INFINIOPS_ATEN_KERNELS)
    target_compile_definitions(InfiniTensor PRIVATE
                               USE_INFINIOPS_ATEN_KERNELS=1)
  endif()
  target_include_directories(InfiniTensor SYSTEM PRIVATE
                             ${INFINIOPS_INCLUDE_DIR})
  if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    target_link_libraries(InfiniTensor ${INFINIOPS_LIBRARY}
                          "-Wl,--no-as-needed" InfiniRT::infinirt
                          "-Wl,--as-needed")
  else()
    target_link_libraries(InfiniTensor ${INFINIOPS_LIBRARY}
                          InfiniRT::infinirt)
  endif()
  set_property(TARGET InfiniTensor APPEND PROPERTY BUILD_RPATH
               "${INFINIOPS_RUNTIME_LIBRARY_DIRS}")
endif()

# TVM backend
if(BUILD_NNET AND BUILD_TEST AND TVM_LIB_DIR)
  target_link_libraries(InfiniTensor ${TVM_LIB_DIR}/libtvm.so)
endif()

# Python bindings
file(GLOB_RECURSE FFIS src/ffi/ffi_infinitensor.cc)
pybind11_add_module(backend MODULE ${FFIS})
target_link_libraries(backend PRIVATE InfiniTensor)
if(USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS)
  target_compile_definitions(backend PRIVATE USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS=1)
  target_include_directories(backend SYSTEM PRIVATE
                             ${INFINIOPS_INCLUDE_DIR})
  target_link_libraries(backend PRIVATE InfiniRT::infinirt)
  set_property(TARGET backend APPEND PROPERTY BUILD_RPATH
               "${INFINIOPS_RUNTIME_LIBRARY_DIRS}")
endif()
if(USE_INFINICCL)
  target_compile_definitions(backend PRIVATE USE_INFINICCL=1)
  target_include_directories(backend PRIVATE ${INFINICCL_INCLUDE_DIR})
endif()

if(USE_BACKTRACE)
  add_definitions(-D BACKWARD_TRACE)
  add_subdirectory(3rd-party/backward-cpp)
  include_directories(3rd-party/backward-cpp)
  add_backward(InfiniTensor)
  target_link_libraries(InfiniTensor dw)
endif()

function(build_test files)
  # Non-recursive glob for skip failed tests
  file(GLOB TEST_SOURCES ${files})
  foreach(testsourcefile ${TEST_SOURCES})
    get_filename_component(testname ${testsourcefile} NAME_WE)
    add_executable(${testname} ${testsourcefile})
    target_link_libraries(${testname} InfiniTensor GTest::gtest_main)
    add_test(NAME ${testname} COMMAND ${testname})
  endforeach(testsourcefile ${TEST_SOURCES})
endfunction()

if(BUILD_TEST)
  add_compile_definitions(BUILD_TEST=1)
  enable_testing()
  if(USE_TRACE)
    build_test(test/trace/*.cc)
  endif()
  if(BUILD_TEST_CORE)
    build_test(test/core/*.cc)
    build_test(test/operators/*.cc)
    build_test(test/kernels/nativecpu/*.cc)
    if(USE_INFINIOPS_KERNELS)
      build_test(test/infini/*.cc)
    endif()
  endif()
  if(BUILD_TEST_PET)
    build_test(test/pet/*.cc)
  endif()
  if(BUILD_NNET AND BUILD_TEST)
    build_test(test/nnet/test_*.cc)

    # Build expression reader
    add_executable(nnet_reader test/nnet/readlog.cc)
    target_link_libraries(nnet_reader InfiniTensor)
  endif()
endif()
